bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; providing a grant to the city of Northrop; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CITY OF NORTHROP.

$230,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the city of Northrop for costs incurred by the city related to an elevator explosion and fire that occurred from December 28 to 30, 2017.
